QuestInfo.name: [Presidential Election] Campaigner (Cole)
QuestInfo.0: Cole gave you a reward and a Contributor Badge. Find out what it's for.
QuestInfo.1: You can get powerful badges if you collect Contributor Badges.
QuestInfo.2: Proudly put on your Campaigner Badge and continue your adventures!

0.0: Well, well, a Contributor Badge? I thought we'd lost them all! Keep them coming.

yes.0: You're easy to persuade and you like hard work. My kind of person!

no.0: Is this the extent of our friendship?

1.0: Did you get more badges? Are you feeling extra contributy now?

yes.0: Splendid! Wear these proud and loud my little friend.

item.0: I'll give you the badge if you collect some more, so get to it!
